job.title: Operations Manager
job.description:
We are hiring a Operations Manager for a health and wellness business in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the day-to-day running of the store and make sure daily tasks are done on time.
  • Supervise and schedule staff, and keep service and hygiene standards high.
  • Manage stock and supplies, and make sure products are available for customers.
  • Handle customer complaints and escalations, and report on sales and operations to the owner.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years' experience in operations, store management or a similar role
  • Good leadership, organisation and communication skills
  • Able to work with little to no supervision
  • Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

  • Other statutory benefits.
